hints.title: Two Invalidation Criteria
hints.text: A transaction is invalid if amount exceeds 1000 or if another transaction with the same name occurs in a different city within 60 minutes.

hints.title: Parse and Index Transactions
hints.text: Parse strings into structured records with name, time, amount, city, and original index. Group transactions by customer name.

hints.title: Cross-Record Conflict Marking
hints.text: For each person, compare pairs of transactions. If their cities differ and their absolute time difference is <= 60, mark both as invalid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs across all users naively without grouping by name takes unnecessary cross-user comparison time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping transactions by customer name partitions comparisons and preserves original string entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should accurately parse string tokens and mark both conflicting transactions when a violation is found.
complexity.notes: Preserves duplicate identical transaction strings if multiple violations occur.
